global_motion_contract.camera: One continuous controlled forward-camera move that belongs to the Scroll World journey; no disconnected portal cut, montage, jump cut, or unrelated replacement scene.
global_motion_contract.first_frame: The founder-approved still is the mandatory first-frame authority and remains the visual identity anchor.
global_motion_contract.product_lock: Garment construction, logos, embroidery, lettering, colors, proportions, hardware, accessories, faces, and body contact may not change through time.
global_motion_contract.environment_lock: Motion may animate atmosphere, practical light, reflection, fabric micro-response, and restrained human movement without replacing the approved world.
global_motion_contract.audio_policy: silent candidate; Scroll World audio is authored separately
global_motion_contract.candidate_boundary: Every generative clip stays quarantined until decoded temporal QA and founder motion approval. No video frame becomes product authority.
global_motion_contract.sampling_plan: Decode first, last, every scene-change frame, and at least one frame per second; increase sampling around fast motion or any detected drift.
